Package neqsim.process.measurementdevice

Class CompressorSurgeMarginMeasurement

java.lang.Object
neqsim.util.NamedBaseClass
neqsim.process.measurementdevice.MeasurementDeviceBaseClass
neqsim.process.measurementdevice.CompressorSurgeMarginMeasurement
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, TransientStateParticipant<CompressorSurgeMarginMeasurement.MarginState>, MeasurementDeviceInterface, TransientMeasurementDevice, ProcessElementInterface, NamedInterface
public class CompressorSurgeMarginMeasurement extends MeasurementDeviceBaseClass implements TransientMeasurementDevice, TransientStateParticipant<CompressorSurgeMarginMeasurement.MarginState>
Holds an explicitly calculated compressor-map margin signal for one physical step.

This is a calculated simulation variable, not a physical flow, pressure or temperature transmitter. Its native source consumes the actual held inlet volume-flow transmitter and the native active surge-curve flow at the declared model head and speed. Pressure and temperature monitoring channels do not acquire causal fault coverage merely by being drawn beside it. The consumed FT, head, speed and map-domain evidence remain frozen with each held sample.
